protocol: Sequential methods on identical input. Synchronized warm replays restore starts. Assembly/reference/validation excluded. Normal method has its own explicit ncv; reference methods use reference_ncv. Pure Warp; normal equations square conditioning. Physical triplets and requested spaces must pass unchanged 1e-8 gates and normal method strict 1e-11 counts. Full-basis products explicitly form the small normal matrix by projecting onto the entire coordinate basis; no Krylov expansion.

graph.method: CUDA graph DOT inspection; not a CUDA API trace

references.notes: Known singular spectrum, two exact zero singular values, independent left/right requested subspaces; top multiplicity three for clustered variant
references.start: Reference seed 2026; restored per trial (algorithms have different start spaces)
references.reason: `ncv` must be an integer satisfying `k < ncv < min(A.shape)`.
